summary.interpretation: Structural sensitivity only. This is not project NPV, project savings, bankability, or a site ranking.

warnings: Reference project ratios are not site estimates.
Fibre values are CRTC funding-intensity proxies, not proven total construction costs.
Unpriced Kristal-specific infrastructure remains outside the calculated headroom.
No generation capex, project revenue, tax, financing, transmission losses, compute hardware or full O&M model is included.
Do not call these values savings, NPV or ROI.
